title: LCH-03 hypercare drill fixture — 50 synthetic sessions (below declared threshold)
description: Deterministic below-threshold control for the LCH-03 synthetic hypercare drill. syntheticSessionCount is 50 against a declaredThreshold of 100, so the harness computes syntheticThresholdMet = false and hypercareWindowAccepted is declared false. Even with elapsedHours recorded, elapsedHoursOnly is false: elapsed time alone never accepts a window. hypercareStatus stays PENDING, productionAcceptance is false, incidentCadence and rollbackAuthority stay PENDING, and no SLO, error-budget, or real-traffic claim is made. It does not modify or duplicate config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production, dataStage synthetic-only, scope browser-only).

authority.note: current-state remains the authoritative manifest; this drill fixture never overrides it. Acceptance here is a bounded synthetic computation (session count vs declared threshold) and never a production hypercare acceptance.

evidence.note: 50 synthetic sessions, below the declared threshold of 100; no session identifier, endpoint, or external evidence exists or is claimed.
